plugins.name: present-to-me
plugins.description: The storytelling method of Wai (Suppanimit Meemungkit) as an agent skill: explain hard things simply with interactive presentations. Starts from a finished deck of the right kind (explainer, versus, decision), with a Grill with me interview, the martini glass story, raised cards, meaningful colour, motion on every press, chart components, 3D anatomy, live parameters and morph continuity between slides.
